ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Greetings? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Greetings.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Greetings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on Greetings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on Greetings has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surah: has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Selected Surah: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah:.

   D. Say Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) has no place in daily life.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

9. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Prophets? (1 mark)

   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

12. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on good Behaviour? (1 mark)

13. Honesty means: (1 mark)

   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust
